name: Dolphin Military
description: Both the Imperial Marines and Confederation Army maintain Dolphin Commando units. Most planetary armies and Home Guards on worlds with a wet navy and Dolphin populations have professional units open to Dolphins. Open to both Dolphins and Orca.

sea_patrol.name: Sea Patrol
sea_patrol.description: You serve as a member of a paramilitary or coast guard unit, which engages in nautical search and rescue, fishery protection and nautical law enforcement duties.

underwater_commando.name: Underwater Commando
underwater_commando.description: You serve in a combat unit that specialises in nautical reconnaissance, underwater demolitions and undersea combat.

guardian.name: Guardian
guardian.description: You serve in a paramilitary force that protects Dolphin clans.

mishaps.1: Injured. Roll on the Injury table.
mishaps.2: You encounter anti-Dolphin prejudice from the force you are working with. You resign in disgust.
mishaps.3: Your unit is involved in a savage campaign against primitive indigenous aquatic aliens that troubles your conscience. If you refuse to participate you are ejected from this career. If you participate in the massacre you may ignore the Mishap and remain in the career but instead you gain an Enemy.
mishaps.4: An ambitious planetary operation goes badly wrong leaving you beached ashore without functional protective gear. Dehydration and skin damage requires lengthy recovery. Lose END -2.
mishaps.5: An investigation uncovers links between your unit's commander and a radical faction. You are given a chance to denounce your commander. If you do so, remain in the career but instead gain one of his allies as an Enemy.
mishaps.6: Injured. Roll on the Injury table.

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishap table but you are not ejected from this career.
events.3: You perform well during a black ops commando mission. Gain DM+2 on your next advancement roll and a Contact in an elite military unit.
events.4: Receive special training in underwater mine disposal. Roll Vacc Suit 4+ to avoid injury; if successful increase Explosives by 1. If you fail roll on the Injury table.
events.5: Spend a lengthy period serving as an auxiliary aboard a spacecraft operating underwater, such as a system defence boat. Roll EDU 7+ to gain your choice of Pilot (Small Craft or Spacecraft) 1 or Electronics (Sensors) 1.
events.6: A brutal amphibious warfare campaign forces you to spend as much time fighting out of water as in. Roll Vacc Suit 7+; if successful, gain one level in Gun Combat, Leadership or Tactics (Military).
events.7: Life Event! Roll on the Life Event table.
events.8: Participate in a major sea battle. Raise Vacc Suit, Melee or Gun Combat by 1 or gain Tactics (Military) 1.
events.9: You are assigned to a joint mission with an intelligence agency to catch spies or insurgents operating near underwater base facilities. Gain an intelligence agent as a Contact and roll 7+ to gain 1 level in Recon or Stealth.
events.10: A mission goes badly wrong when a human leader disregards your advice because you are 'just a Dolphin' and then blames you for their mistake. If you accept this suffer DM-1 on your next advancement roll. If you protest, roll Advocate or SOC 8+; success means they are dismissed and you gain DM+1 to your next Advancement roll and gain 1 level in Leadership or Advocate. Failure results in DM-2 on your next advancement roll.
events.11: A senior officer takes an interest in your career. Gain DM+2 on your next advancement roll and Admin 1 or Tactics (Military) 1.
events.12: Display heroism in battle. Your next advancement roll is automatically successful.
